meta.description: About Kathleen Citrine — Wholistic Wellness Artist, Alchemist & Uplifter based in Laguna Beach.

title: Kathleen
paragraphs: Kathleen is a Wholistic Wellness Artist, Alchemist & Uplifter — weaving a golden tapestry of art, wellness and healing modalities including energy work, qigong, poetry, prose, painting and photography.

She has been training in quantum energy alchemy and healing for over 15 years and experiencing myriad methods for her own healing to remember her own wholeness. Kathleen is a Certified Reiki Practitioner and has formal training in Quantum Energy Healing work, Bioenergetic Chinese Medicine, Qigong and Vinyasa Yoga. She is avid about whole foods nutrition and hydration, light and sound, natural medicine, nature and shamanic tools.

While she has learned most viscerally and valuably through life experiences and her intuition — which precipitated her formal trainings — she discovered that qigong was a key missing link and foundation for total self-inpowerment, energetic hygiene, balancing and cultivation. This was especially important to her being highly sensitive and intuitive to energies, and an absolute gamechanger on her journey of remembering her strength and sovereignty, which is why she is so passionate about sharing this miraculous medicine.

One of her specialties is expressing in her energy work and art the ancient healing language of the Soul through her spoken and sung Light Language. This evokes a celestial lovingjoy of remembrance of the truth of who we really are — a beautiful and magnificent sacred inner sun shining star.

Kathleen is an Ambassador for Mother Earth with a profound connection to the ocean, the sun, the sand, the seagulls and the spirit of Laguna Beach, for which is home and where she draws her nourishment, replenishment, inspiration and joy. She experiences Mother Earth Laguna — and of nature and life itself — as a symphonic thanksgiving and infinite blessing of divine grace, appreciating the love in and of everyone and everything.
She has been creating art since she was a young child, beginning with writing and illustrating her first book at age 8.

Currently Kathleen is working on a special painting series entitled LIGHT OF LOVE™, which has served as a catalyst for her HEART Alchemy™ sessions. She is also fine-tuning a very special work of art coming soon — one she is so excited to share with the world and all resonant Souls.
